## Checklist

- [ ] I read `FRAMEWORK.md`
- [ ] The line item passes the admission test: it would appear as its own row in
      a model someone actually builds
- [ ] The concept does not already live in another entry under another name
- [ ] Purpose through Rules is 250 words or fewer
- [ ] I added the reciprocal `draws_from` / `feeds` references to every
      neighboring entry I named
- [ ] Variants are rules on the base entry, not separate files
- [ ] `python tools/validate.py` passes
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`)
